method: We kept zero-ozone ENERGY STAR air purifiers certified for rooms of 250 sq ft or less and compared those with the highest smoke CADR, weighing smoke CADR 80% and the five-year electricity cost 20% (cost is scored against the page's cheapest unit; a heavier cost weight would put the cheapest-to-run unit first even when it cleans far slower) (certified yearly energy use x current EIA U.S. average residential price x 5).
name: Best air purifiers for small rooms (up to 250 sq ft), ranked by certified data
scoring: each value scored against the best on the page (best = 1), times its weight; total out of 100

excluded.why: conservative choice: only units that report 0 ppb ozone in certification; UL's zero-ozone test (UL 2998) cannot quantify low readings, so this also drops units whose small non-zero reports are not reliably different from 0

selection.label: Smoke CADR
selection.merge: listings with identical certified values on all 23 reported fields
